summary: Verizon Communications Inc. filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on May 11, 2026, solely to disclose a list of registered securities, including common stock and various fixed-rate notes with maturities from 2026 to 2056. No corporate event, transaction, or special situation is described; the filing appears to be a routine administrative update of outstanding securities. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change involved. The document is a standard current report without any event-driven content.
